info.description:
# CareID Enterprise Backend — Staging Integration Collection

Official API collection for the **CareID / Health Vault 360** clinical, identity, and governance platform backend.

## Deployment Context
- **API Base URL:** `https://360api.vnvision.in`
- **Local Fallback:** `http://localhost:3000` or `http://localhost:3073`
- **API Versioning:** All endpoints are prefixed with `/api/v1`
- **Database Engine:** PostgreSQL with Prisma ORM (144 clinical & administrative tables)
- **Environment:** Staging / Testing with seeded synthetic datasets

## Authentication Flows & Automation
1. **Password Authentication (`POST /api/v1/auth/password/login`):**
   - Standard unified password authentication across all platform roles (`SUPER_ADMIN`, `ADMIN`, `DOCTOR`, `PATIENT`, `STAFF`, `FACILITY_ADMIN`, `FAMILY_MEMBER`).
   - Body: `{ "identifier": "superadmin@careid.test", "password": "{{adminPassword}}" }`
   - On success, the test script **automatically saves** `accessToken`, `access_token`, `refreshToken`, `refresh_token`, and `userId` / `user_id` into your active environment and collection variables.
2. **Admin Email & Password Authentication (`POST /api/v1/auth/admin/login` - Legacy Alias):**
   - Strictly reserved for verified accounts with `ADMIN` or `SUPER_ADMIN` roles. Maintained for backwards compatibility.
   - Body: `{ "identifier": "admin@careid.test", "password": "{{adminPassword}}" }`
   - On success, the test script **automatically saves** tokens and user identifiers into active variables.
3. **Phone OTP Authentication (`POST /api/v1/auth/otp/request` & `verify`):**
   - Used by all 7 platform roles (`PATIENT`, `DOCTOR`, `STAFF`, `FACILITY_ADMIN`, `FAMILY_MEMBER`, `ADMIN`, `SUPER_ADMIN`).
   - Call `POST /api/v1/auth/otp/request` with phone number (e.g. `{{patientPhone}}`). The `challengeId` is **automatically captured**.
   - Call `POST /api/v1/auth/otp/verify` with `{{stagingOtpCode}}` (`123456`). The issued tokens are **automatically saved**.
   - All 400+ authenticated endpoints inherit `Bearer {{accessToken}}` automatically.
4. **Token Refresh (`POST /api/v1/auth/token/refresh`):**
   - Automatically rotates and updates `accessToken` / `access_token` before expiration.

## Seeded Staging Test Accounts
| Role | Allowlisted Phone | Staging OTP | Seeded Email | Name & Function |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **SUPER_ADMIN** | `+16505550001` | `123456` | `superadmin@careid.test` | CareID Super Administrator (Full platform control) |
| **ADMIN** | `+16505550002` | `123456` | `admin@careid.test` | System Administrator (Users, Audit logs, Clinics) |
| **DOCTOR** | `+16505550003` | `123456` | *(N/A)* | Dr. Sarah Jenkins, MD (Clinical Encounters & Prescriptions) |
| **PATIENT** | `+16505550004` | `123456` | *(N/A)* | John Doe (Health Vault, Profile, Digital Health Card) |
| **FACILITY_ADMIN** | `+16505550005` | `123456` | *(N/A)* | Metro Facility Admin (Hospital, Departments, Wards) |
| **STAFF** | `+16505550006` | `123456` | *(N/A)* | Alice Smith, RN (Nurse / Triage Desk, Vital Signs) |
| **FAMILY_MEMBER** | `+16505550007` | `123456` | *(N/A)* | Jane Doe (Family Vault, Dependent Records) |

*Notice: Fixed test OTP `123456` is strictly restricted to these 7 phone numbers on staging. Unlisted numbers receive 401 Unauthorized.*
